**Layout**

Title sits top-left at about 6.4% from left and 6.5% from top, set flush left over two lines. Below it a two-by-two grid of rounded white panels with thin lavender-grey outlines: the top-left panel is wide (about 5.7% to 57.9% across), the top-right is narrower (59% to 94.3%), and the bottom row mirrors this widths, with the lipid table panel on the left and the hsCRP chart panel on the right. Each panel has a full-width navy header bar with centred white bold text. The source and abbreviation footnotes sit bottom-left under the panels, the Zealand Pharma logo sits bottom-left corner, and the page number 74 sits bottom-right at about 96.7% from left.

**Visuals**

Four charts and one table. (1) Line chart 'Mean systolic blood pressure': y axis titled 'Change from baseline in systolic blood pressure (mmHg)' ranging 0 to -10.0 with ticks 0, -2.5, -5.0, -7.5, -10.0; x axis 'Weeks since randomization' with ticks 0, 8, 20, 36, 52, 68 and an axis break near 68; dashed black zero reference line; series Placebo grey #8A8F8F ending at -3.2, Cagrilintide navy #141865 ending at -5.3, Semaglutide light blue #9DB1CF ending at -7.5; vertical error bars on every point; line markers are filled circles. Values at intermediate points are about. (2) Line chart 'Mean diastolic blood pressure': y axis titled 'Change from baseline in diastolic blood pressure (mmHg)' ticks 0, -1, -2, -3, -4; x ticks 0, 8, 20, 36, 52, 68; dashed zero line; Placebo ends at -1.9 (about -1.6 at week 8), Cagrilintide ends at -3.5 (about -2.6 at week 8), Semaglutide ends at -4.5 (about -2.0 at week 8); error bars present. (3) Line chart 'Mean pulse at baseline: 73.2 beats/min': y axis titled 'Change from baseline in pulse (beasts/min)' ticks 5.0, 2.5, 0.0, -2.5; x ticks 0, 8, 20, 36, 52, 68; dashed zero line; Semaglutide light blue about 2.4 at 8, about 3.9 at 20, about 3.0 at 36, about 2.4 at 52, ends 1.17; Placebo grey about -0.6, -1.4, -0.3, -0.5, ends -0.58; Cagrilintide navy about -2.2, -3.8, -1.5, -3.2, ends -3.31; error bars on points. (4) Table: columns Ratio to baseline in lipids | Placebo (n=705) grey header | Cagrilintide (n=302) navy header | Semaglutide (n=302) light blue header | Significance; rows Total cholesterol 0.99 0.99 0.94 NS; HDL cholesterol 1.01 1.06 1.07 NS; LDL cholesterol 0.99 0.99 0.93 NS; VLDL cholesterol 0.96 0.86 0.78 NS; Non-HDL cholesterol 0.98 0.96 0.90 NS; Triglycerides 0.96 0.86 0.78 NS; Free fatty acids 1.02 1.02 0.94 NS; value cells tinted pale grey, lavender and near-white by column; thin navy row rules. (5) Bar chart 'Absolute reduction in hsCRP' with no chart title: y axis titled 'Absolute change in C-reactive protein' ticks 0.0, -20.0, -40.0, -60.0; three bars: Placebo (n=705) grey -13.4, Cagrilintide (n=302) navy -35, Semaglutide (n=302) light blue -51, value labels under each bar; no legend. (6) Zealand Pharma logo: coloured circles Z (blue), E (grey), A (yellow), L (teal), & (red) with ZEALAND PHARMA wordmark beneath. (7) Decorative pale cyan-teal gradient wash in the top-right corner.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a pale cyan-teal gradient wash in the top-right corner. White background. Title in Space Grotesk Light, black #000000, about 5.9% of slide height, two lines at comfortable leading. Panel headers in Space Grotesk Bold white #FFFFFF about 2.6% of slide height on navy #141865 bars. Chart and body text in Space Grotesk Regular black #000000 about 1.8% of slide height; table and some labels in Space Grotesk Light. **Layout**

Full-bleed white slide with a title block across the top spanning two left-aligned lines starting at about 6.4% from the left edge. A large rounded-corner grey-outlined panel holds a bar chart with six columns above a table of adverse events, with dashed black rectangles marking the 3 mg column and the 3/6/9 mg column. Source lines sit bottom-left beside the ZEAL PHARMA logo and the page number 75 sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Vertical bar chart titled Weight loss after 48 weeks (efficacy estimand) on the y-axis, with the y-axis running from 0 at the top down to -25 at the bottom in steps of 5 percent, and a horizontal zero baseline. Six bars hang down from the zero line, each labelled with its value: Placebo -0.4% (about -0.4, very thin pale bar), Eloralintide 1 mg -9.5%, Eloralintide 3 mg -12.4%, Eloralintide 6 mg -17.6%, Eloralintide 9 mg -20.1%, Eloralintide 6/9 mg -19.9%, Eloralintide 3/6/9 mg -16.4%. Bars use a grey ramp from very light grey #E7E8E8 for 1 mg to near-black #3B3B3B for 3/6/9 mg, with the placebo bar pale blue. No legend. Dashed black rectangles highlight the Eloralintide 3 mg column and the Eloralintide 3/6/9 mg column. A red rounded callout box with red text sits over the lower right of the chart. Below the chart is a table titled Select AEs (%) with column headers from the bar columns, six rows (Nausea, Vomiting, Diarrhea, Constipation, Fatigue, Alopecia) and seven value columns in the order Placebo, 1 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, 9 mg, 6/9 mg, 3/6/9 mg. Alternating columns carry translucent grey tint fills of increasing darkness from left to right.

**Design**

Background: Plain white #FFFFFF background with a faint pale blue-green gradient wash in the top-right corner. Plain white background. Title text in black #000000 Space Grotesk Light, sans-serif geometric, about 5.9% of slide height. Body and chart labels in black #000000 Space Grotesk Regular with bold for the Female and Base BMI lines and the bold axis title. Callout text bold red #C00000. Chart bars in greys #E7E8E8, #D5D4D4, #C0BEBE, #959595, #6C6969 and #3B3B3B. Table column tints are translucent greys at 20 percent opacity with a pale blue #CEF3F6 at 13 percent in the placebo column. Outer panel has a thin grey rounded border about 1 px. Dashed highlight rectangles use heavy black dashes with square corners. Footnote text is grey #898D8D at about 1.5% of slide height. Table rows are separated by thin black horizontal rules.

**Layout**

Two-part layout on a white slide: a two-line left-aligned title sits in the top band starting at about 6.4% from the left edge, above a large rounded white card with a thin grey-blue border spanning about 5.7% to 94.3% of the width and 21.6% to 86.2% of the height. Inside the card, a line chart occupies the left portion, with a centred 'Mean relative change at Week 32' heading and two rounded value pills plus a legend to its right; a small logo and three-line source footnote sit at the bottom left and the page number sits at the bottom right.

**Visuals**

Line chart with two series, titled by the navy header bar 'Phase 2 trial in people with type 2 diabetes'. X axis: 'Time since randomization (weeks)', labelled ticks 0, 4, 8, 12, 20, 28, 32 (range 0 to 32). Y axis: 'Mean (SE) change in body weight (%)', labelled ticks 0, -2, -4, -6, -8, -10, -12, -14 (range 0 to -14). Series 1 Semaglutide 2.4 mg (n=31): light blue-grey line #9DB1CF with round markers and vertical error bars with caps; about 0 at week 0, about -0.6 at week 4, about -1.2 at week 8, about -1.9 at week 12, about -3.3 at week 16, about -4.2 at week 20, about -4.5 at week 28, and -5.1% at week 32 (printed). Series 2 Cagrilintide 2.4 mg (n=30): dark navy line #141865 with filled round markers and error bars; about -1.5 at week 4, about -2.5 at week 8, about -3.3 at week 12, about -4.2 at week 16, about -5.7 at week 20, about -7.3 at week 28, and -8.1% at week 32 (printed, the final point is highlighted by the navy pill). A black dashed horizontal reference line marks 0%. Error bars are thin black vertical lines with horizontal end caps; no value labels are printed on the plot except the week 32 values. Legend at right: light blue-grey line with circle marker for Semaglutide 2.4 mg (n=31) and navy line with filled circle marker for Cagrilintide 2.4 mg (n=30). Two rounded pills to the right of the plot: upper pill light grey-blue (-5.1%) and lower pill darker grey-blue (-8.1%) with navy text, highlighting the week 32 values.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a faint pale cyan gradient glow in the top-right corner. Clean white slide with a faint pale cyan-to-white gradient glow in the top-right corner. Title in Space Grotesk Light, black #000000, about 5.9% of slide height, left aligned, two lines with tight leading. Card header bar is solid navy #141865 with white (#FFFFFF) Space Grotesk Bold text about 3.3% of slide height, centred. Body and axis labels in Space Grotesk Regular black #000000 about 2.2% of slide height; chart heading and pill values in Space Grotesk Bold about 2.6%. Footnotes in Space Grotesk Light grey #898D8D about 1.5% of slide height. Card has white fill with a thin 1px grey-blue border (#B8C4D8) and rounded corners of about 1.1% of slide width; navy header has matching rounded top corners. Pills have rounded corners of about 50% radius, no shadows, no gradients. Accents: navy #141865 for Cagrilintide and header; light blue-grey #9DB1CF for Semaglutide; pill fills #001965 at 15% opacity and #9DB1CF at 15% opacity.

### Slide 78

**Text**

Amylin holds transformative potential
for chronic weight management
We need a toolbox to address one of the greatest healthcare challenges of our time, not just a hammer
Amylin represents a distinct new modality that can expand the chronic weight management toolbox
Potential to deliver the weight loss that most people with overweight and obesity desire, with considerably improved GI tolerability
For specific segments, combining amylin with incretin-based therapy offers strong potential for additional therapeutic benefits
Using the maximum dose of the better-tolerated agent and optimizing the less tolerable agent may boost efficacy without compromising GI tolerability
GI=GI=gastrointestinal.
78

**Layout**

Left-aligned title block in the upper left (two-line title, one-line subtitle beneath it) with a left margin of about 6.4% of slide width. Below it, four full-width horizontal pill-shaped rows are stacked with even vertical spacing of about 4.5% between them, each row starting at about 5.7% from the left and ending at about 94% from the right. Footer sits at the bottom: Zealand Pharma logo at bottom left, footnote beside it, and page number at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Four rows, each a pill-shaped band with a solid saturated colour cap on the left end and a pale tint of the same colour extending to the right. Each cap holds a white circle (about 8.7% wide by 15.5% tall) with a thin coloured ring that overlaps the boundary between cap and tint. Inside each circle is a line icon: row 1 (blue) a toolbox with a hammer and a wrench above an open-top box; row 2 (teal) a simple outline of a person with a cap and shoulders; row 3 (amber) a chain link made of two linked oval loops; row 4 (red) two vertical arrows, one pointing up on the left and one pointing down on the right, with a small horizontal cross between them. No charts, tables or photographs. The background image is a decorative soft aqua-cyan gradient glow in the top-right corner only. Logo: Zealand Pharma logo, five overlapping coloured circles carrying the letters Z, E, A, L and & (blue, grey, yellow, teal and red), with the words ZEALAND PHARMA beneath in small grey bold capitals.

### Slide 83

**Text**

Petrelintide is a long-acting,
potential best-in-class amylin analog
Petrelintide is a 36-amino-acid acylated peptide, based on the peptide sequence of human amylin1
Human amylin backbone (intentionally avoiding sCT due to potential safety and tolerability concerns)1
Potent balanced agonistic effects on AMY-1R, AMY-3R, and CTR (motivated by extensive screening)1,3
Chemical and physical stability around neutral pH (allowing for co-formulation and co-administration with other peptides, and reducing the risk of injection site reactions and immunogenicity)2,3
Consistent half-life of 10 days, suitable for once-weekly administration and potentially important for tolerability4,5
~85% bioavailability1,5, potentially important for efficacy and COGS
Zealand Pharma has a collaboration and license agreement with Roche for petrelintide, including co-development and co-commercialization in the U.S. and Europe.
Sources: Data on file; Eriksson et al. Poster 532. Presented at ObesityWeek, November 1-4, 2022, San Diego, CA; Skarbaliene et al. Poster 1406-P. Presented at ADA 82nd Scientific Sessions, June 3-7, 2022, New Orleans, LA; Braendholt Olsen et al. Poster 92-LB. Presented at ADA 83rd Scientific Sessions, June 23-26, 2023, San Diego, CA; Data presented at ObesityWeek 2024 in San Antonio, TX.
AMY-1R=amylin-1 receptor; AMY-3R=amylin-3 receptor; COGS=cost of goods sold; CTR=calcitonin receptor; sCT=salmon calcitonin.
83
ZEALAND PHARMA

Single-column layout on a white slide with a left margin of about 6 percent and a right edge near 94 percent. The two-line title sits top-left, left-aligned, in the upper 20 percent of the slide. The footer has the Zealand Pharma logo at bottom-left, a three-to-four-line grey footnote block starting at about 11.5 percent from the left, and the page number 83 at bottom-right.

Five circular icons, each a dark blue #0058A3 disc with white line-art inside, set on a pale blue-grey #E3ECF5 ring. Row 1 icon: a chain of small open circles forming a curved backbone. Row 2 icon: a small figure-like symbol with a branching Y shape and a vertical stem. Row 3 icon: two interlocked chain links. Row 4 icon: a stopwatch or timer with a dial. Also a Zealand Pharma logo at bottom-left made of five coloured circles carrying the letters Z, E, A, L and ampersand, in blue, grey, yellow, teal and red, with the wordmark ZEALAND PHARMA beneath. No photographs.

**Layout**

Two-tier structure: a left-aligned two-line title sits at the top between about 6.5% and 19% of the slide height, with a single chart panel below it spanning about 5.7% to 94.3% of the width and from 21.6% to 86.0% of the height. Inside the panel, a full-width blue header band carries the subtitle, then four column groups (Petrelintide, Eloralintide, Met-233i, ABBV-295) sit over a shared bar chart with a dashed vertical divider after the Petrelintide group. A footnote block sits bottom-left at about 11.5% from the left, with the ZEAL& logo at bottom-left and the page number at bottom-right (about 96.6%, 93.7%); the left margin is about 6.4% and the right margin about 3%.

**Visuals**

Chart: vertical bar chart of placebo-adjusted weight loss one week after a single dose, in percent (%), from indirect comparison of SAD trials. Y-axis: linear, 0.0 at top to -5.5 at bottom, labelled every 0.5 (0.0, -0.5, -1.0, -1.5, -2.0, -2.5, -3.0, -3.5, -4.0, -4.5, -5.0, -5.5); thin black axis line; bars grow downward from a black zero baseline spanning the chart width. Bars left to right, each with its printed value: Petrelintide 0.7 mg -3.2%, 1.4 mg -4.2%, 2.4 mg -4.8%; Eloralintide 1.2 mg -0.1%, 4 mg -1.9%, 12 mg -3.3%; Met-233i 0.6 mg -3.0%, 1.2 mg -3.8%, 2.4 mg -5.3%; ABBV-295 3.5 mg -2.8%, 4.75 mg -3.8%, 6.0 mg -3.2%. Petrelintide bars are solid blue; comparator bars are grey in four tones with varying opacity. No legend; group names above the bars serve as the legend, with the Petrelintide group highlighted in blue and the comparator groups in grey. Callout boxes (white fill, grey thin outline, small pointer) annotate: Petrelintide 0.7 mg No nausea and vomiting; 1.4 mg 17% vomiting; Eloralintide 4 mg No nausea and vomiting; 12 mg 17% vomiting; Met-233i 0.6 mg 17% vomiting at first effective dose; 1.2 mg 67% vomiting; ABBV-295 3.5 mg 17% vomiting at first effective dose; 4.75 mg 33% vomiting. Dashed black vertical line separates the Petrelintide group from the comparators. No photographs or illustrations.

**Layout**

Full-width title in two lines across the top, left-aligned at about 6.4% of slide width. Below it a single large rounded rectangle outline encloses three equal columns (SAD trial, MAD trial Part 1, MAD trial Part 2) separated by thin vertical rules at about 35% and 64.6% of width. Each column has a header box, a bar chart with a horizontal baseline, a Tolerability heading with underline, and bullets; footer footnotes sit bottom-left with a logo and page number 85 at bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Three vertical bar charts of percent change in body weight from baseline, drawn as bars hanging down from a shared horizontal black baseline. SAD trial (Day 7): Placebo (N=6) 0.6% (small grey bar above baseline, about 0.6), 0.7 mg (N=6) -2.6%, 1.4 mg (N=6) -3.6%, 2.4 mg (N=6) -4.2%. MAD trial Part 1 (week 6): Placebo (N=6) -0.4%, 0.6 mg (N=7) -5.3%, 1.2 mg (N=7) -5.1%. MAD trial Part 2 (week 16): Placebo (N=12) -1.7%, 2.4 mg (N=12) -4.8%, 4.8 mg (N=11) -8.6%, 9.0 mg (N=10) -8.3%. Bars are blue-grey graded from pale to dark left to right within each chart; the placebo bar is mid grey. Values are printed under or above each bar; no axis, scale, or legend is drawn. No highlighted points. Each chart has a column header label above the baseline with dose and N. No photographs, logos other than the Zealand Pharma logo at bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: White #FFFFFF with a faint pale aqua gradient glow in the top-right corner. Clean white background with a faint pale aqua gradient glow in the top-right corner. Title in Space Grotesk Light, black #000000, about 5.9% of slide height per line. Header boxes are solid blue #0058A3 rounded rectangles with white Space Grotesk Bold headings (about 3.0% of slide height) and Regular sub-lines. Chart subtitles in Space Grotesk Bold black about 2.2%. Dose labels and values in Space Grotesk Regular/Light grey #4F4F4F about 2.2%. Tolerability headings in Space Grotesk Bold blue #0058A3 about 2.6%. Bullets in Space Grotesk Regular black #000000 about 2.1% with blue #0058A3 Arial bullet dots. **Layout**

Single-column title block at top-left over two lines, followed by one large rounded-corner panel spanning almost the full width, split into three columns: a left study-design column (about 55% of panel width), a middle column with the ZUPREME-1 values, and a shaded right column with the 16-week Phase 1b values. A header band across the top of the panel carries the takeaway sentence, centred. Footnotes and sources sit in a small block at the bottom left with the Zealand Pharma logo at far left and the page number at bottom right; left margin about 6%, right margin about 6%.

**Visuals**

Left column: a circular check-mark icon (solid #0058A3 disc with thin white tick, inside a pale #CCDEED halo ring) beside three lines of timing text. Below it, a Gantt-style dosing schedule of six horizontal rounded bars stacked top to bottom: Petrelintide dose group 5 (#002C52), dose group 4 (#00427A), dose group 3 (#0058A3), dose group 2 (#669BC8), dose group 1 (#CCDEED, black text), Placebo (#898D8D). Each bar carries a white label except dose group 1. A second, narrower column of matching bars sits to the right of the first set, representing follow-up. Beneath the bars is a horizontal black timeline with dots at weeks 0, about 16, 28, 42 and the follow-up start and end, labelled 'Week', '0', 'Dose escalation', '16', '28', '42' and 'Follow-up'. Middle column: four rows with black line icons at left: a bathroom scale with footprints (Weight), a gauge labelled BMI in blue (BMI), a person with magnifier and figures (Age), and a male and female figure pair (Female). Each row has a bold label, a value with tilde, and a grey value in the right column. The values printed are: Weight ~107 and 92; BMI ~37 and 30; Age ~48 and 47; Female ~53 and 21. No chart axes, legend or highlighted data points; the timeline dots are the only markers.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a faint pale aqua wash at the top-right corner. White background with a faint pale aqua-to-white wash in the top-right corner. Titles in black #000000, body text black #000000, accents and emphasis in blue #0058A3, secondary text in grey #4F4F4F and footnotes in grey #898D8D. Typeface is Space Grotesk throughout: the title is Light, subtitle and headings are Bold, body is Regular, footnotes are Light. Title text is about 5.9% of slide height, body text about 2.2% to 2.6%, footnotes about 1.5%. Panel uses a thin grey #898D8D outline with corner radius about 2.5% of slide height and tinted fills at 10% opacity of #0058A3 and #898D8D. Bars are fully rounded pills with no shadow. Icons are thin-line blue #0058A3 outlines. No shadows or gradients on panel.

### Slide 90

**Text**

Phase 2 trial with petrelintide/CT-388 / planned for initiation in H1 2026 / Zealand Pharma and Roche aim to maximize the dose of petrelintide a / and optimize the dose of CT-388 / Petrelintide as the foundation a / Strategic objectives of the Phase 2 trial / Identify the doses that maximize weight loss / efficacy whilst optimizing the experience / Identify and select optimal dose(s) to / move forward to Phase 3 / Placebo-controlled trial with inclusion of / active comparator arms / (petrelintide and CT-388 monotherapy) / Zealand Pharma has a collaboration and license agreement with Roche for petrelintide, including co-development and co-commercialization in the U.S. and Europe. / a Pending ZUPREME-1 Phase 2 monotherapy data with petrelintide. / 90

**Layout**

Single white slide with a left-aligned two-line title at top left (left margin about 6.4% of width, title block from about 6.5% to 19% of height). A full-width pale blue-grey band (y 21.8% to 32.8%) carries a centred two-line blue subtitle, with the Zealand Pharma logo at the left and the Roche logo at the right. Below, two equal columns (left x 5.8% to 49.5%, right x 50.8% to 94.5%) each start with a teal-outlined rounded header box at y 36.9%; a dashed vertical divider at x 50% separates them. The right column is split by a horizontal dashed line at y 64% into two stacked items, each with a teal check-circle icon above centred text. Footer: small Zealand Pharma logo bottom left, two lines of grey footnote text beside it, and the page number 90 at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Five non-text visuals. (1) Line chart in the left column, drawn in teal #23AEB7 with no title, no axis labels, no tick values and no legend: a vertical y-axis line and a horizontal x-axis line form an L at the bottom left; about five faint dotted horizontal gridlines run across the plot; a single smooth teal curve falls steeply from the top left and flattens toward the lower right, with about 10 round teal markers placed along it. No printed values; the curve is a declining trend, no points are highlighted. (2) Line-art illustration of a laboratory microscope in teal #23AEB7 outline with a solid teal tilted tube, a flat stage with a small pill-shaped object, and a base; to its right, three test tubes in outline with solid teal liquid fill in the lower part, linked by a thin outline line at the bottom. (3) Teal check-circle icon above the first right-column item: a solid teal #23AEB7 circle with a white outline check mark, set in a pale aqua halo. (4) Identical teal check-circle icon above the second right-column item. (5) Dashed teal horizontal rule across the right column at about 64% of height, and a dashed teal vertical divider at x 50%. Photographs: none.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF with a faint aqua gradient wash in the top-right corner fading to white. Title in black #000000, Space Grotesk Light, about 5.9% of slide height, two lines with tight leading. Subtitle in bold blue #0058A3 Space Grotesk Bold, about 3.3% of height. Column headers in bold teal #23AEB7 Space Grotesk Bold, about 3.0% of height, inside white rounded rectangles with a 1 px teal #23AEB7 outline and corner radius about 1.5% of height. Body text black #000000 Space Grotesk Regular about 3.0% of height, with key phrases in bold teal #23AEB7. Band fill #DCE7F0, no border. Footnotes in light grey #898D8D Space Grotesk Light about 1.5% of height. Dividers are dashed teal lines, about 1 px. No shadows or gradients on shapes.

### Slide 91

**Text**

Petrelintide holds potential as a future foundational
therapy for weight management
Weight loss – Potential for ~15–20% reduction in body weight as monotherapy 1-3
Safety and tolerability – Potential for better tolerability compared to incretins, including less frequent and less severe GI AEs, leading to overall better patient experience and improved treatment persistence 1-3
Mechanism of action – Reduces food intake by restoring leptin sensitivity and enhancing satiety, making people feel full faster, rather than suppressing appetite 4
Cardiovascular disease – Potential to reduce CVD risk (e.g., through effects on blood pressure, heart rate, lipids, and hsCRP) 1-3
Potential of petrelintide to meet most needs as monotherapy and serve as the backbone in combination with CT-388 for added weight loss and/or improved glycemic control
ZEALAND PHARMA
Zealand Pharma has a collaboration and license agreement with Roche for petrelintide, including co-development and co-commercialization in the U.S. and Europe
Sources: 1Brændholt Olsen et al. Data presented at ObesityWeek 2023 in San Antonio, TX; 2Garvey et al. N Engl J Med 2025;393(7):635–647; 3Billings et al. Lancet 2025 doi: 10.1016/S0140-6736(25)02155-5; 4Roth et al. Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A 2008;105(20):7257–7262.
AE=adverse event; CVD=cardiovascular disease; GI=gastrointestinal; GLP-1RA=glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist; hsCRP=high-sensitivity C-reactive protein; MoA=mechanism of action.

**Layout**

Two-column composition on a full-bleed gradient with a narrow left column holding the title and a central column of four stacked stages (Idea, Discovery, Medical, Patients) joined by a vertical timeline rule. The right block holds a 2x2 grid of black-and-white portraits with captions above a bold pull statement. Title sits top-left at about 10% from the top with a left margin of about 5.7%; the footnote runs along the bottom from about 11.5% with the logo at bottom-left and the page number at bottom-right (about 97%, 94%).

**Visuals**

Four black-and-white portrait photographs in a 2x2 grid on the right: top-left Utpal Singh, top-right David Kendall, bottom-left Steven Johnson, bottom-right Steven Smith. Each is a head-and-shoulders shot, subject centred, framed from chest up, with neutral indoor backgrounds (grey-toned windows and frosted glass on the top row and left, a dark grey backdrop behind Steven Smith). Lighting is soft and frontal, greyscale, with mid-grey and near-black tones. Photos are rectangular, unrounded and unbordered. Two vertical black timeline rules with black filled dots at their ends: a long rule at about 40% of the width from top edge to the Patients stage, and a rule at about 65% from the pull statement down to the bottom edge. Three pairs of thin teal double-headed vertical arrows between the four stages, each about 6% of the height long, pointing up and down. Zealand Pharma logo at bottom-left: five overlapping coloured circles reading Z, E, A, L and & in blue, grey, yellow, teal and red, with the wordmark ZEALAND PHARMA beneath in dark navy caps.

**Design**

Background is a pale gradient from white at left and centre to mint #D8F6F2 and aqua #B5ECEC at the right and bottom-right edge. Title text is black #000000 in Space Grotesk Light, about 5.9% of slide height per line, sentence case, tight leading. Stage headings are Space Grotesk Bold in teal #23AEB7 at about 3.7% of height. Stage descriptions are Space Grotesk Light in teal #23AEB7 at about 2.4% of height. Portrait names are Space Grotesk Bold in black #000000 at about 1.8% of height; job titles are Space Grotesk Light in black at about 1.8%. Pull statement is Space Grotesk Bold in black #000000 at about 2.8% of height with tight leading. Footnote and page number are Space Grotesk Light in grey #898D8D at about 1.5% of height. Lines are thin black strokes of about 1 px; dots are solid black; arrows are thin teal #23AEB7 strokes with small arrowheads. No corner radii, shadows or gradients on shapes beyond the background.

**Layout**

Two columns: a left column of two stacked teal-headed cards (The Visible Epidemic above The Hidden Epidemic) and a right column holding one boxed table titled Consequences of metabolic imbalance. The title sits top-left at about 7% from the top with a subtitle line beneath it, both left-aligned at x 6.4%. A small NON-EXHAUSTIVE label is right-aligned above the right column at y 22%. Italic note sits under the right box, sources and abbreviations sit in a footer band at the bottom left, the Zeal Pharma logo sits bottom-left and the page number 96 sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Four-row list of organ icons in the right box, drawn as black line icons on white: a human heart (Cardiovascular disease), a pancreas (T2D and beta cell failure), a liver with dots (MASH), and a pair of kidneys (CKD / DKD). Two circular teal people icons, one per left card: the Visible Epidemic icon shows three solid dark figures (one black centre figure, two white side figures); the Hidden Epidemic icon shows the same three figures with the side figures faded to pale teal and the centre figure dark teal, suggesting less visible obesity. A faint cyan gradient wash in the top-right corner of the background. No photographs.

**Design**

Background: Plain white #FFFFFF with a faint cyan gradient wash in the top-right corner. Clean white background with a faint cyan gradient wash in the top-right corner. Titles and body text in black #000000; Space Grotesk Light for body and title, with bold for card headings and key figures. Accent teal #23AEB7 for card headers, circles, outlines and highlighted key numbers. Right box header black #000000 with white bold text; bottom band light grey (black at 10% opacity, about #E6E6E6). Title about 5.9% of slide height, body text about 3.3%, footer about 1.5%. Card outlines are thin teal lines about 1px with rounded corners about 1.5% of slide width; the card headers have rounded top-right corners. Right box has rounded corners and a thin black outline. No shadows.

Two large rounded panels sit below the timeline: a grey panel on the left and a pale teal panel on the right, each containing a descending curved line with nodes and labels. A footer with the logo and footnote sits bottom-left and the slide number sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Left of the lower area: a grey-filled rounded panel containing a curved black line with four open black-outlined circular nodes, each labelled with text (Maximize GLP-1 receptor engagement; Suppress appetite resulting in aversive responses; Extend PK from QD to QW; More is better), and a central target icon with an arrow through concentric circles above the label 'Weight loss Olympics'. Right of the lower area: a pale teal rounded panel containing a curved teal line with three teal-outlined circular nodes each holding a line icon: a computer chip icon (next to 'Tune cross-axis signaling with greater acceptability'), a brain icon (next to 'Restore hypothalamic sensitivity to peripheral signals'), and a muscle/cell icon with arrows (next to 'Build peripheral metabolic capacity'). A teal balance scale icon sits above the text 'Quality & Durability Era'. Timeline: a horizontal bar running full width at about 37% from the top, shading from black at the left to teal #23AEB7 at the right, with seven circular nodes: four black-outlined white circles under Liraglutide, Semaglutide, Tirzepatide and the left-side area, and teal-outlined white circles under Survodutide and Petrelintide. Logo at bottom-left: ZEALAND PHARMA logo with six coloured circles spelling Z, E, A, L, & in blue, grey, yellow, teal and red, with 'ZEALAND PHARMA' text beneath in grey. Background shows a faint pale cyan gradient glow in the top-right corner.

98

**Layout**

Two-part slide: a large two-line title sits top-left at the left margin (about 6.4% from the left edge), above a single large rounded-corner white panel with a thin light-teal border spanning about 15% to 94% of the width. A narrow column of three circular teal line icons runs down the left margin, and a source footnote with the Zeal&Pharma logo sits in the bottom-left footer, with the page number right-aligned at the bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Anatomical diagram of the adipose-GI-brain hormone axis. Left: a cluster of about four orange-yellow fat cells (adipose tissue) with pale peach outlines and small blue-tinted vessels, labelled Adipose tissue. Centre-top: a sagittal brain illustration in beige, pink and light blue with a red hypothalamus, labelled Hypothalamus with a leader line, and a Hindbrain label with leader line below it. Upper right: a yellow oval labelled Vagal afferents with a yellow line running from the brain to the gut. Right: a pink and salmon illustration of the stomach and intestines (GI tract), with a yellow omentum patch on the stomach, labelled GI tract. Lower left: a dark red liver with a green gall bladder, labelled Liver. Centre-bottom: a yellow-orange pancreas labelled Pancreatic islets. Arrows: thick teal #23AEB7 arrows with rounded heads run from the GI tract and pancreas toward the brain and liver; thin teal connector lines link each teal pill label to its organ. Pill labels, all teal with white text: Ghrelin (arrow from GI tract to hypothalamus), Leptin (from adipose to brain), LEAP2 (from brain-side arrow to liver), Insulin (from pancreas up to brain), Amylin (from pancreas to hindbrain), PYY3-36 (from brain arrow to intestine), GLP-1 (to intestine), GIP (to intestine), Glucagon (arrow from pancreas to liver). Bottom band text is a teal-coloured statement. Left column: three circular icons with teal outlines: a microchip icon in a grey-filled circle, a brain icon in a white circle, and a muscle icon in a white circle, connected by a teal curved line.

**Design**

Background: White #FFFFFF full-slide background with a faint pale cyan gradient haze (#E6F7F8) in the top-right corner. Clean light scientific style on a white background with a faint cyan haze at the top-right corner. Title in Space Grotesk Light, black #000000, size about 5.9% of slide height, two lines with tight leading. Pill labels in Space Grotesk Light, white on teal #23AEB7. Diagram labels in Space Grotesk Bold italic black #000000 at about 2.2% of slide height. Bottom statement in Space Grotesk Bold teal #23AEB7 at about 3.3% of slide height. Footnote in Space Grotesk Light grey #898D8D at about 1.5% of slide height. Panel: white fill with a 1px light teal border (#A8DDE0) and corner radius about 1.5% of slide width. Bottom band inside the panel is teal #23AEB7 at 10% opacity (about #E8F6F7). No shadows or gradients inside the panel.

Diagram 1 (left, Human amylin): a ring-and-chain diagram of 37 amino acids drawn as black circles with white letters, with two white circles marked C linked by a line (disulfide bridge). The chain forms a loop with a tail; the visible sequence reads K C N T A T C A T Q R L A N F L V H S S N N F G A I L S S T N V G S N T Y, with the N-terminus at the upper-left and C-terminal NH2 shown as a white pill at the left with the label 37 above and 1 below. Diagram 2 (right, Petrelintide): a chain of about 37 circles, most black with white or black letters, with amino acids marked in yellow (modifications important for physical and chemical stability) at positions 2 D, 3 N, 7 K, 10 Q, 14 E*, 17 Q, 18 R, 21, 22 (yellow), 24 G*, 26 I*, 31 E; a single teal circle (acylation) at the N-terminus labelled γE with R at 1; a teal-tinted chemical structure box above it with the fatty-diacid chain drawn with two O atoms and OH, labelled n=14; a dashed black arrow from the label 'Important for potency' points down to the white circle P* with NH2 at position 37; a disulfide link drawn as a black line from D2 to K7. Arrow: solid light grey triangle pointing right between the two diagrams. Legend: yellow filled circle and teal filled circle with black outline, each beside its label. Timeline: black double horizontal rule with four white year tabs. Small dashed black vertical leaders with black dots connect the callouts to the years. No photographs.

**Design**

Background is white with a faint pale cyan (#CFF3F5) gradient glow in the top-right corner. Title text is black #000000 in SpaceGrotesk Light, about 5.9% of slide height. Callout body text is black #000000 in SpaceGrotesk Light about 2.0%; the purple box uses grey body text #4F4F4F. Purple header #7030A0 with white bold title. Lavender body #F0EAF5 with a thin purple #7030A0 outline and rounded corners about 1% of height. Teal accent #23AEB7 on the petrelintide heading, acylation circle and bold section label. Yellow modification circles #F5B000. Grey band is black at 10% opacity (rendered #E6E6E6). Grey callout boxes are black at 10% (#E6E6E6) with square corners. Year tabs are white #FFFFFF boxes with bold black SpaceGrotesk text about 2.6% of height. Footer sources text is grey #898D8D SpaceGrotesk Light about 1.5% of height. Amino-acid circles are black #000000 with white letters. Shapes have no visible shadows.

No printed values on the chart; the percentages are estimates. The ring has a plain white centre with no value labels, axis, or gridlines. ### Slide 114

**Text**

Strong financial terms and commitments / Petrelintide and petrelintide/CT-388 / Survodutide / Roche / Boehringer Ingelheim / 50% profit share in U.S. and Europe / Tiered double-digit % royalties on net sales in RoW ranging up to high-teens / Up to USD 1.2bn^a in outstanding development milestones / • Incl. USD 575m for Phase 3a initiation and USD 575m for Phase 3b initiation with petrelintide monotherapy / USD 125m (x2) in anniversary payments (2026+2027) / Up to USD 2.4bn in sales-based milestones / No CAPEX by Zealand Pharma related to commercial supply / Solely responsible for development and commercialization globally / High single-digit to low double-digit % royalties on global sales / EUR 315 million outstanding in potential milestone payments / a Zealand Pharma will pay Roche USD 350 million for the contribution of CT-388 in the first combination product arising from the collaboration. The payment will become due in four installments throughout 2026-27. / CAPEX=capital expenditure; RoW=rest of world (outside U.S. and Europe). / 114 / ZEALAND PHARMA

**Layout**

Two equal columns of rounded-top panels sit side by side below a left-aligned two-line title at upper left; the left panel (Petrelintide) spans roughly x 5.6 to 49.7 and the right panel (Survodutide) x 51.2 to 94.2, both from y 21.8 to 89.4. Footnote text runs along the bottom from x 11.5 with the Zealand Pharma logo at bottom left and the slide number 114 at bottom right near x 96.6, y 94.3.

**Visuals**

Two greyscale, washed-out photographs fill the lower bodies of the panels. Left panel: a waterfront city view with tall modern towers and a river, lightened with a white overlay, boxed inside a rounded-top panel. Right panel: a modern glass office building with trees in the foreground, lightened with a white overlay, boxed inside a rounded-bottom and rounded-top panel. Roche logo: blue (#154AD3) hexagonal outline with the word Roche in blue, centred above the left list. Boehringer Ingelheim logo: dark green (#08312A) circular emblem with vertical bars and an arrow above the words Boehringer Ingelheim in serif type, centred above the right list. Blue horizontal rules (#154AD3, thin) divide the left list; dark green horizontal rules divide the right list. Zealand Pharma logo: five coloured circles (blue, grey, yellow, teal, red) containing the letters Z, E, A, L and & with ZEALAND PHARMA beneath. No charts or tables.

**Design**

Background: White background with a faint pale cyan gradient in the top-right corner, with the two greyscale photographs placed inside the panels. White slide background with a faint pale cyan gradient glow in the top-right corner. Title in Space Grotesk Light, black #000000, about 5.9% of slide height. Panel headers in Space Grotesk Bold, white #FFFFFF, about 3.0% of slide height on solid fills: blue #154AD3 (left) and dark green #08312A (right). Body text in Space Grotesk Light, black #000000, about 2.2% of slide height. Key figures and emphasis in Space Grotesk Bold, blue #154AD3 on the left and dark green #08312A on the right, at about 3.0% (left) and 2.6% (right) of slide height. Panels have large rounded corners (top corners on headers, all corners on bodies). Footnote text in Space Grotesk Light, grey #898D8D, about 1.5% of slide height. Superscript a is about 2.0%. The bullet is Arial, black.
